name: Claymation
description: A breakfast kitchen turns to plasticine, thumbprints and all, and the subject with it.

wardrobe.man: a striped blue and white shirt and an apron
wardrobe.woman: a striped blue and white shirt and an apron
wardrobe.person: a striped blue and white shirt and an apron

scene_prompt: Create a new cinematic film still in {aspect_words} format. {references} The {subject} is the only person in the new still, with exactly {their} face, eyes, nose, jaw, hairline, hairstyle, hair colour{facial_hair}, skin tone and build{identity_notes}. The clothing, the place and the light come only from this description. The {subject} stands at a kitchen counter in a sunny retro kitchen in the morning, facing the camera, wearing {wardrobe}, holding a frying pan with an egg in it. Mint green cabinets, a checkered floor, a bowl of fruit, a toaster and a window with yellow curtains. Medium shot at eye level, the {subject} centered behind the counter. Cinematic photography, bright morning sun from the window on the left, cheerful pastel colors. Correct human anatomy, natural skin texture, sharp focus on the {subject}, plain unbranded appliances throughout.
effect_prompt: Use the provided start image as the first frame. The {subject} ALREADY stands at the counter holding the pan. Everything turns into plasticine claymation: the cabinets, the fruit, the toaster and the pan become smooth modelling clay with visible thumbprints and soft rounded edges, the colors become bright clay colors, and the {subject} becomes a clay figure with the same face and hair sculpted in clay, who flips the clay egg in the pan and grins at the camera, all of it moving in slightly stepped handmade stop motion. The camera holds a steady medium shot. Sound: a soft squishy clay sound, a sizzle of the pan, a cheerful pop of the egg landing. Photorealistic, cinematic visual effects, handmade plasticine claymation, sharp detail, stable picture.
generic_prompt: Use the provided start image as the first frame. Everything turns into plasticine claymation: every surface becomes smooth modelling clay with visible thumbprints and soft rounded edges, the colors become bright clay colors, and the {subject} becomes a clay figure with the same face and hair, all of it moving in slightly stepped handmade stop motion. The camera keeps the same framing and the same movement it already has. Sound: soft squishy clay sounds, small handmade clicks. Photorealistic, cinematic visual effects, handmade plasticine claymation, sharp detail, stable picture.
